**Result:** `test/pricing.test.ts` now passes all 3 tests (subtotal, applyDiscount, tax). I did not touch `src/inventory.ts` or `src/checkout.ts`. The diff stat also shows changes in those two files, which came from the other agents, not from me. I did not commit.
